notes: Meaning disagreement (1 of 40): 'Belt Tensioner Bracket' was Arabic «دعامة شدّاد السير». Bare «دعامة» is the glossary word for print supports («الدعامات»); the glossary term for bracket is «دعامة تثبيت». Fixed to «دعامة تثبيت شدّاد السير». The Sorani «پایەی توندکەرەوەی قایش» is unambiguous and was kept.

Same wrong term outside the sample: 'Tray bracket connector' Arabic «موصل دعامة الصينية» fixed to «موصل دعامة تثبيت الصينية» (Sorani kept). These are the only two rows changed in out/008.json; every other row is byte-identical.

Style-only differences, not counted and not changed: «تعرّف أكثر على» versus «اعرف المزيد عن» in the Wiki lines; «الأيسر» versus «اليسرى» (Left Hotend Heating Assembly); Sorani 'Wiping Pad' «پەدی سڕین» versus «بالشتکی سڕینەوە»; a Latin ';' after '*1' where Arabic punctuation «؛» would also do; 'MC Board' left in Latin inside «لوحة MC Board» (not a listed name; harmless, slightly redundant); «گڵۆپی LED ی یاریدەدەر» writes the izafe ی as a separate word.

Names and codes: every listed name in the sample (AMS 2 Pro Power Board, AMS HT …, P2 Series, Induction Hotend Rack Control Board, 3513 Induction Hotend Rack Motor, Bambu Lab) stays verbatim in both languages; all part codes (BT2.6, BT2x8, ST3x24x7, PW2.2x4.8x0.3, M3x4.5, MC-AP) and digits survive. No Sorani row copies the Arabic. No price, stock or shipping text.

Whole file checked with the real validateTranslationRow (packages/catalog/src/bambuImport/i18n.ts in the feat/import-i18n worktree) with names.json and IDENTITY: 248 rows, 0 failures, before and after the fixes.

Light read of the 208 rows outside the sample found no other meaning errors. 'For H2D/H2C' and 'For H2S' are option names in names.json, so «للخيار For H2D/H2C» keeps them verbatim as the rules require.
